notes.title: WHY DID THE CHICKEN CROSS THE ROAD? - START PATREON PAGE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024131/7baa13247cb543344fb8008b9d828753984bd4c0.png[/img]

Now you'll finally know why the chicken crossed the road.



Hi, I'm Antonio Masteroka! My team and I are making [b]Why did the chicken cross the road?[/b], an upcoming roguelike & bullet hell game for PC and (hopefully) consoles. [b]Choose your chicken, upgrade your gun and get the answer to the eternal question![/b] The game is currently in development and we need you to make it true. You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2987520/Why_Did_The_Chicken_Cross_The_Road/]add the game to your Steam wishlist[/url] now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024131/6305be82fbb70028ff7e70928d5c0c5b302ce954.png[/img]

★ [b]Strong gunplay core:[/b] It is based on succesful titles like «Nuclear Throne» or «Enter the Gungeon». With a strong investment in Gamefeel to make every bullet shot as satisfactory as possible.

★ [b]Modify with no limits:[/b] The modifier system allows you to upgrade your weapon and explore hundreds of thousands of combinations. You can turn a pistol into a explosive shotgun in just a few steps.

★ [b]Choose your chicken: [/b]Each playable chicken have different stats and special skills that makes them different to play.

★ [b]Build your own road: [/b]You can choose your own path and how levels are created in order to boost your strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024131/6976aca93f15b028f2ee0c9f2ff711a8589ebfcc.png[/img]

Let's be clear, video game development is becoming more and more complicated. We are living in difficult times, with large studios closing and less and less investment for small studios.


We believe that right now we have to be united. It's the perfect time to create something together and [b]involve everyone in the development[/b] of the game. If you join this community you can be part of the joke and find out before anyone else [u]"Why did the chicken cross the road?"[/u]


[b]You will have access to different documents and videos about the development, contribute ideas, vote in polls and more.[/b]

[previewyoutube=48V3e_wrGdQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Learn more about the Patreon rewards [url=https://www.patreon.com/guatequegames]here.[/url]
